model:
rachana: 1
sutra: dividend-curve
version: 1
description: 
match: { kind: dividend-curve, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "Market data · Dividend curve", id: "$.CURVE_ID" }
strip:
  - { label: "Underlier", bind: "$.UNDERLIER" }
  - { label: "Yield", bind: "$.DIVIDEND_YIELD", fmt: "pct2", emphasis: true }
panels:
  - id: divs
    kind: hbar
    title: "Expected dividends"
    key: "F2"
    phone: { tier: "glance", from: "fragment", rows: 5 }
    rows: "$.POINTS"
    label: "YEAR"
    value: "AMOUNT"
    fmt: "price2"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
  - id: refs
    kind: links
    title: "Linked entities"
    code: "REFS"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
keys: { F7: "link($.UNDERLYING_EQUITY, 'equity')", F8: "impact", F9: "raw" }
